title: I saw a reading of #table17play back in feb and I am SO happy I was i...
transcript: I'm gonna remind you right now, don't call your ex. You'll thank me later. Because table 17 makes it look extremely appealing. This is one of the most romantic plays I have ever seen. And it's all about a breakup. Or more specifically, the fallout of a breakup two years down the line. But that doesn't mean it's not funny. It's in fact extremely funny cause written by Douglas Lyons, who is able to perfectly balance hilarity with but punching brutal moments. And luckily he has found a cast that is oozing with chemistry with Tony winner, Kara Young and Bico Eisen Martin, who played Jada and Dallas, couple who are no longer together but are both clearly not quite ready to move on. They're sitting at table 17 seeing each other for the first time in years. After you flashbacks, you watch them fall in love and fall apart. Michael Ryan plays all the other characters and he is so good at it. Table 17 is such a unique in on a romcom and I just love everything about it, especially how they encourage the audience to react and engage. They break the fourth wall a lot, but it just feels really comfortable. It's playing until September 22nd at MCC. Go see it.
